dessin:
A star diagram. At the center (x 40-52%, y 40-60%): a geodesic point symbol (a small triangle with a dot in its center) surrounded by three concentric brown contour rings.
Around it, a ring of seven small pale format sheets with ink outlines, each with a different map pattern inside, at these centers: (14%, 50%) blue water; (24%, 30%) cadastre parcels; (46%, 25%) building footprints; (68%, 30%) brown contour lines; (76%, 50%) roads; (64%, 72%) green vegetation; (28%, 72%) aerial image raster (green-grey pixel mosaic). Each sheet about 11% wide and 13% high.
Blue routes (#2F6DA8, round caps) go from the three left sheets (water, parcels, raster) to the center; red routes (#C4472B, round caps) go from the center to the four other sheets.
Top left corner of the drawing area (x 3-12%, y 22-34%): a small pale card with two standing human silhouettes.

elements.centre: the geodesic point triangle with its concentric brown rings at the center
elements.feuilles: all seven small format sheets around the center (one box enclosing the whole ring of sheets)
elements.lire: the blue routes going into the center (one box enclosing them)
elements.ecrire: the red routes going out of the center (one box enclosing them)
elements.fondateurs: the small card with two silhouettes at the top left
